title.sk: Ovsená kaša s jablkom a škoricou
title.en: Oat porridge with apple and cinnamon

description.sk: Hrejivé raňajky za 10 minút, ktoré zasýtia až do obeda.
description.en: A warming 10-minute breakfast that keeps you full until lunch.

steps.sk: Vločky s mliekom priveď do varu a na miernom ohni var 4 až 5 minút za stáleho miešania, kým kaša nezhustne.
steps.en: Bring the oats and milk to the boil and simmer over low heat for 4–5 minutes, stirring, until thick.

steps.sk: Medzitým nastrúhaj jablko a vmiešaj ho do kaše spolu so škoricou.
steps.en: Meanwhile, grate the apple and stir it into the porridge with the cinnamon.

steps.sk: Podávaj pokvapkané medom a posypané nasekanými orechmi.
steps.en: Serve drizzled with honey and sprinkled with chopped walnuts.

title.en: Scrambled eggs with chives on bread

description.sk: Krémová praženica na masle – najrýchlejšie teplé raňajky.
description.en: Creamy scrambled eggs in butter: the quickest hot breakfast.

steps.sk: Vajcia rozšľahaj so soľou.
steps.en: Beat the eggs with the salt.

steps.sk: Na panvici na miernom ohni rozpusti maslo, vlej vajcia a stierkou ich pomaly posúvaj od okrajov do stredu.
steps.en: Melt the butter over low heat, pour in the eggs and slowly push them from the edges to the centre with a spatula.

steps.sk: Keď sú vajcia takmer stuhnuté, ale ešte lesklé (asi po 3 minútach), stiahni ich z ohňa – dotiahnu sa samy.
steps.en: When the eggs are almost set but still glossy (about 3 minutes), take them off the heat; they finish cooking on their own.

steps.sk: Okoreň, posyp pažítkou a podávaj na chlebe.
steps.en: Season with pepper, sprinkle with chives and serve on the bread.

title.sk: Tvarohová nátierka s reďkovkou a pažítkou
title.en: Quark spread with radish and chives

description.sk: Svieža nátierka plná bielkovín, hotová za päť minút bez varenia.
description.en: A fresh, protein-rich spread ready in five minutes with no cooking.

steps.sk: Tvaroh vymiešaj s jogurtom dohladka.
steps.en: Beat the quark with the yogurt until smooth.

steps.sk: Reďkovky nakrájaj na drobné kocky, pažítku nasekaj a oboje vmiešaj do tvarohu.
steps.en: Finely dice the radishes, chop the chives and stir both into the quark.

steps.sk: Osoľ, okoreň a natieraj na chlieb. V chladničke vydrží 2 dni.
steps.en: Season with salt and pepper and spread on the bread. Keeps in the fridge for 2 days.

description.sk: Chrumkavý celozrnný chlieb, krémové avokádo a vajíčko so žĺtkom, ktorý tečie.
description.en: Crispy wholegrain bread, creamy avocado and an egg with a runny yolk.

steps.sk: Chlieb opeč v hriankovači alebo na suchej panvici.
steps.en: Toast the bread in a toaster or a dry pan.

steps.sk: Avokádo roztlač vidličkou s citrónovou šťavou a soľou.
steps.en: Mash the avocado with the lemon juice and salt.

steps.sk: Na oleji usmaž vajcia, kým bielky nestuhnú a žĺtky sú ešte tekuté, asi 3 minúty.
steps.en: Fry the eggs in the oil until the whites are set and the yolks still runny, about 3 minutes.

steps.sk: Chlieb natri avokádom, navrch polož vajce a posyp čili.
steps.en: Spread the avocado on the toast, top with an egg and sprinkle with chili.

title.sk: Grécky jogurt s ovocím, orechmi a medom
title.en: Greek yogurt with fruit, nuts and honey

description.sk: Raňajky bez varenia s množstvom bielkovín.
description.en: A no-cook breakfast with plenty of protein.

steps.sk: Jogurt daj do misky a navrch rozlož ovocie.
steps.en: Spoon the yogurt into a bowl and top with the fruit.

steps.sk: Vločky a nasekané orechy krátko opraž na suchej panvici, kým nezavoňajú, a posyp nimi jogurt.
steps.en: Toast the oats and chopped walnuts briefly in a dry pan until fragrant and sprinkle them over the yogurt.

steps.sk: Pokvapkaj medom.
steps.en: Drizzle with honey.

description.en: Thin crêpes filled with vanilla quark.

steps.sk: Múku, mlieko, vajcia, soľ a lyžicu oleja vyšľahaj na hladké riedke cesto a nechaj ho 10 minút odpočinúť.
steps.en: Whisk the flour, milk, eggs, salt and a tablespoon of oil into a smooth, thin batter and let it rest for 10 minutes.

steps.sk: Plnka: tvaroh vymiešaj s cukrom, vanilkovým cukrom a citrónovou šťavou.
steps.en: Filling: beat the quark with the sugar, vanilla sugar and lemon juice.

steps.sk: Panvicu potri trochou oleja, vlej tenkú vrstvu cesta a krúživým pohybom ho rozlej. Peč asi minútu, kým okraje nezačnú hnednúť, otoč a dopeč 30 sekúnd.
steps.en: Brush a pan with a little oil, pour in a thin layer of batter and swirl to spread it. Cook for about a minute until the edges brown, flip and cook for 30 seconds.

steps.sk: Palacinky natri tvarohom, zroluj a podávaj.
steps.en: Spread the crêpes with the quark, roll up and serve.

description.sk: Rastlinné raňajky, ktoré sa urobia samy cez noc.
description.en: A plant-based breakfast that makes itself overnight.

steps.sk: Datle nasekaj nadrobno a s chia semienkami ich zamiešaj do sójového mlieka.
steps.en: Finely chop the dates and stir them into the soy milk with the chia seeds.

steps.sk: Po 10 minútach znova premiešaj, aby sa nevytvorili hrudky, a daj aspoň na 4 hodiny do chladničky.
steps.en: Stir again after 10 minutes so no lumps form, then refrigerate for at least 4 hours.

steps.sk: Mango nakrájaj na kocky a podávaj na pudingu posypané kokosom.
steps.en: Dice the mango and serve on the pudding, sprinkled with coconut.

description.sk: Chlieb namočený vo vajíčku a mlieku, opečený dozlatista.
description.en: Bread soaked in egg and milk, pan-fried until golden.

steps.sk: Vajcia rozšľahaj s mliekom, škoricou a cukrom v plytkej mise.
steps.en: Whisk the eggs with the milk, cinnamon and sugar in a shallow dish.

steps.sk: Plátky chleba v zmesi z oboch strán namoč, aby nasiakli, ale nerozpadli sa.
steps.en: Dip the bread slices on both sides so they soak up the mixture without falling apart.

steps.sk: Na masle ich opekaj na strednom ohni 2 až 3 minúty z každej strany dozlatista.
steps.en: Fry in the butter over medium heat for 2–3 minutes per side until golden.

steps.sk: Podávaj s ovocím, podľa chuti poprášené práškovým cukrom.
steps.en: Serve with the berries, dusted with powdered sugar if you like.

title.sk: Mexické vajcia s fazuľou a tortillou
title.en: Mexican eggs with beans and tortilla

description.en: A hearty breakfast inspired by huevos rancheros.

steps.sk: Na polovici oleja speň nakrájanú cibuľu s cesnakom, pridaj rímsky kmín, čili, paradajky, fazuľu a soľ a var 6 minút.
steps.en: Soften the chopped onion and garlic in half the oil, add the cumin, chili, tomatoes, beans and salt and simmer for 6 minutes.

steps.sk: Tortilly zohrej na suchej panvici a polož na taniere.
steps.en: Warm the tortillas in a dry pan and put them on plates.

steps.sk: Na zvyšnom oleji usmaž volské oká s tekutým žĺtkom.
steps.en: Fry the eggs in the remaining oil, keeping the yolks runny.

steps.sk: Na tortilly rozlož fazuľovú omáčku, navrch vajcia a podľa chuti avokádo a koriander.
steps.en: Spread the bean sauce over the tortillas and top with the eggs and, if you like, avocado and coriander.

description.sk: Rastlinná obdoba praženice s kurkumou, plná bielkovín.
description.en: A plant-based scramble with turmeric, full of protein.

steps.sk: Na oleji opekaj nakrájanú cibuľu a papriku 4 minúty.
steps.en: Fry the chopped onion and pepper in the oil for 4 minutes.

steps.sk: Tofu rozdrob rukami priamo do panvice, pridaj kurkumu, cesnak, soľ a korenie a opekaj 4 minúty.
steps.en: Crumble the tofu straight into the pan with your hands, add the turmeric, garlic powder, salt and pepper and fry for 4 minutes.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj špenát, nechaj ho zavädnúť a podávaj s chlebom.
steps.en: Stir in the spinach, let it wilt and serve with bread.

description.sk: Detská klasika, ktorá poteší v každom veku.
description.en: A childhood classic that pleases at any age.

steps.sk: Mlieko s cukrom a soľou priveď do varu.
steps.en: Bring the milk to the boil with the sugar and salt.

steps.sk: Za stáleho miešania metličkou pomaly vsýpaj krupicu a var 3 minúty, kým kaša nezhustne.
steps.en: Whisking constantly, slowly pour in the semolina and simmer for 3 minutes until thick.

steps.sk: Rozdeľ do tanierov, navrch daj kúsok masla a posyp kakaom zmiešaným s práškovým cukrom.
steps.en: Divide between plates, top with a little butter and sprinkle with the cocoa mixed with powdered sugar.

title.sk: Proteínové smoothie s banánom a arašidovým maslom
title.en: Protein smoothie with banana and peanut butter

description.en: A quick high-calorie snack after training.

steps.sk: Všetko daj do mixéra a mixuj 30 sekúnd dohladka.
steps.en: Put everything in the blender and blend for 30 seconds until smooth.

steps.sk: Ak je smoothie príliš husté, prilej trochu mlieka. Pi hneď.
steps.en: If it is too thick, add a splash of milk. Drink right away.

description.en: A salty, crunchy snack instead of crisps.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 200 °C. Cícer prepláchni a dôkladne osuš utierkou – čím je suchší, tým bude chrumkavejší.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Rinse the chickpeas and dry them thoroughly with a towel; the drier they are, the crunchier they get.

steps.sk: Premiešaj ho s olejom, korením a soľou a rozlož na plech v jednej vrstve.
steps.en: Toss with the oil, spices and salt and spread in a single layer on a baking tray.

steps.sk: Peč 30 až 35 minút, v polovici premiešaj. Hotový je, keď je zlatistý a chrumká.
steps.en: Bake for 30–35 minutes, stirring halfway. They are done when golden and crunchy.

steps.sk: Nechaj vychladnúť na plechu. V uzavretej nádobe vydrží 3 dni.
steps.en: Let them cool on the tray. Keeps in an airtight container for 3 days.

description.sk: Opečený chlieb so šťavnatými paradajkami a cesnakom.
description.en: Toasted bread with juicy tomatoes and garlic.

steps.sk: Paradajky nakrájaj na drobné kocky, osoľ, premiešaj s polovicou oleja a natrhanou bazalkou a nechaj 5 minút postáť.
steps.en: Dice the tomatoes, salt them, mix with half the oil and the torn basil and let stand for 5 minutes.

steps.sk: Chlieb opeč dochrumkava na suchej panvici alebo v hriankovači.
steps.en: Toast the bread until crisp in a dry pan or toaster.

steps.sk: Teplý chlieb potri rozpoleným strúčikom cesnaku a pokvapkaj zvyšným olejom.
steps.en: Rub the warm toast with the cut garlic clove and drizzle with the remaining oil.

steps.sk: Navrch daj paradajky, podľa chuti pokvapkaj balzamikom a hneď podávaj.
steps.en: Top with the tomatoes, add a few drops of balsamic if you like and serve right away.

description.sk: Krémový avokádový dip s limetkou a koriandrom.
description.en: A creamy avocado dip with lime and coriander.

steps.sk: Avokádo roztlač vidličkou s limetkovou šťavou a soľou – nechaj ho trochu hrudkovité.
steps.en: Mash the avocado with the lime juice and salt, leaving it a little chunky.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu, paradajku, koriander a čili.
steps.en: Stir in the finely chopped onion, tomato, coriander and chili.

steps.sk: Mrkvu a uhorku nakrájaj na tyčinky a podávaj s dipom.
steps.en: Cut the carrots and cucumber into sticks and serve with the dip.

description.sk: Obľúbená nátierka na chlebík, s jogurtom namiesto majonézy.
description.en: A favourite sandwich spread, with yogurt instead of mayonnaise.

steps.sk: Vajcia var 10 minút natvrdo, schlaď ich v studenej vode a ošúp.
steps.en: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes until hard, cool them in cold water and peel.

steps.sk: Nastrúhaj ich na hrubom strúhadle alebo roztlač vidličkou.
steps.en: Grate them coarsely or mash with a fork.

steps.sk: Zmiešaj s jogurtom, horčicou, nadrobno nakrájanou cibuľou a pažítkou, osoľ a okoreň.
steps.en: Mix with the yogurt, mustard, finely chopped onion and chives and season with salt and pepper.

steps.sk: Podávaj na chlebe. V chladničke vydrží 2 dni.
steps.en: Serve on bread. Keeps in the fridge for 2 days.

title.sk: Cuketové placky s fetou a kôprom
title.en: Zucchini fritters with feta and dill

description.sk: Grécke kolokithokeftedes: chrumkavé zvonka, jemné vnútri.
description.en: Greek kolokithokeftedes: crisp outside, tender inside.

steps.sk: Cuketu nastrúhaj, posoľ a po 10 minútach z nej v utierke vytlač čo najviac vody.
steps.en: Grate the zucchini, salt it and after 10 minutes squeeze out as much water as you can in a tea towel.

steps.sk: Zmiešaj ju s rozdrobenou fetou, vajcami, múkou, nakrájanou cibuľkou, kôprom a korením.
steps.en: Mix with the crumbled feta, eggs, flour, sliced spring onion, dill and pepper.

steps.sk: Na oleji opekaj lyžicou tvarované placky 3 minúty z každej strany dozlatista.
steps.en: Fry spoonfuls of the mixture in the oil for 3 minutes per side until golden.

steps.sk: Nechaj odkvapkať a podávaj s jogurtom.
steps.en: Drain and serve with yogurt.

description.sk: Chrumkavé tyčinky na párty aj k polievke.
description.en: Crispy straws for parties or with soup.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 200 °C a plech vylož papierom na pečenie.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 200 °C and line a baking tray with parchment.

steps.sk: Cesto rozvaľkaj, potri rozšľahaným vajcom a posyp polovicou syra, paprikou a rascou. Preklop napoly a jemne pritlač.
steps.en: Unroll the pastry, brush with beaten egg and sprinkle with half the cheese, the paprika and caraway. Fold in half and press gently.

steps.sk: Nakrájaj na prúžky široké 1,5 cm, každý niekoľkokrát skrúť, potri vajcom a posyp zvyšným syrom.
steps.en: Cut into 1.5 cm strips, twist each a few times, brush with egg and sprinkle with the remaining cheese.

steps.sk: Peč 12 až 15 minút do zlatista.
steps.en: Bake for 12–15 minutes until golden.

description.sk: Osviežujúci indický jogurtový nápoj s mangom.
description.en: A refreshing Indian yogurt drink with mango.

steps.sk: Mango ošúp a nakrájaj dužinu.
steps.en: Peel the mango and cut up the flesh.

steps.sk: Rozmixuj s jogurtom, mliekom a medom dohladka a podávaj vychladené.
steps.en: Blend with the yogurt, milk and honey until smooth and serve chilled.
